detail.title: Intex 150m Wireless Mini USB Adapter - Int WiAd 150
detail.overview: Stay connected with the compact and efficient 150 Mbps Wireless Mini USB Adapter, powered by the trusted Realtek RTL8188FTV chipset. Supporting 802.11 b/g/n wireless technology, this adapter delivers stable wireless connectivity for desktops, laptops, and DVR systems. Compatible with both Windows and macOS, it's the ideal plug-and-play solution for wireless internet access with added security and DVR support.
